data.one_liner: A lightweight CLI logger with prompts, progress, and custom styling.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Logger class for stdout logging, user prompts, progress bars, and hyperlink support. It is used by the Mason CLI and can be used in any Dart console app.
use_when: Building command‑line tools that need user interaction
Adding structured logs to a Dart CLI
Creating progress indicators for async tasks
avoid_when: Needing a logging framework for mobile or web apps
strengths: Simple API, no build_runner or codegen
Built‑in prompt, choice, and progress utilities
weaknesses: No async stream or file logging support
Limited to Dart CLI, not Flutter
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec and import package:mason_logger/mason_logger.dart

alternatives.name: logger
alternatives.why_pick_it: Standard Dart logger with similar API but without prompt utilities
